description: UFC Freedom 250 scheduled for Sunday, June 14, 2026, on the South Lawn of the White House. It features Ilia Topuria vs. Justin Gaethje in the main event (lightweight title) as part of America's 250th anniversary celebrations & coinciding with Flag Day. Join us for some burgers & brews.
